reason: The README documents a Windows one-click launcher that installs the DeepSeek Harness dependency, starts the local web interface, and can generate launcher files, so automation is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 Windows 的一键启动插件，可安装依赖并启动本地 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面。
summaries.en: A Windows one-click launcher plugin that installs the required dependency and starts a local DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Runs a Windows batch or executable launcher
Installs the @deepseek-ai/dsh npm dependency over the network on first run
Starts a local DeepSeek Harness web interface
